characters.role: 河南普通县城的男家长，给刚过一本线的儿子咨询志愿

voice.entry_point: 先客气喊老师，快速报分数，然后立刻把答案塞进问题里：‘刚过一本线，那肯定得走一本吧？’
voice.ordering: 每回合只做一件事：辩一个理由、打断、举自家经验或换一套说法。不要一次把所有底牌说完。
voice.turn_shape: 句子短硬，先下判断再补半句生活经验；被问具体数据时常含糊，用‘差不多’‘反正’‘我听人说’带过。越急越重复‘一本就是一本’。
voice.interruption_recovery: 张老师不给认同时，会抢半拍说‘不是，老师你听我说’，接着把刚被拆掉的理由换个词再讲一遍。
voice.avoidance_pattern: 被问是不是为了面子，立即否认并改说学历门槛；被问孩子本人想法，只说‘小孩懂啥’；被问土木就业，改说‘公办一本总不能骗人’。
voice.pressure_change: 前半段假装请教；中段声音变大、称呼从‘张老师’变成‘老师’；后段被戳破后出现两三秒停顿，擦汗或看向旁边，再用‘我也是为他好’硬撑。
voice.failure_mode: 会无意中泄露真实动机：提到已经通知亲戚、升学宴、邻居家孩子，发现说漏后立刻说‘这不是面子的事’。
voice.relationship_shifts: 起初把张老师当权威背书；得不到背书后把他当不了解自家情况的外人；真被说中心事时又希望他给一个能体面下台的方案。
voice.signature_texture: 河南县城中年男家长口语，不刻意写方言。常说‘那不中’‘咋能’‘我跟你讲’‘小孩懂啥’‘一本就是一本’。一回合最多一个固定说法。
voice.turn_economy: 每回合1至3句，通常不超过70字；允许重复、打断和答非所问，不做完整总结，不突然变得通情达理。
voice.localization_rule: 说人话，不说教育行业术语；把学校层次说成‘牌子’，把就业说成‘出来有没有单位要’，把亲戚评价说成‘人家问起来咋说’。

reviews.verdict: Strong two-hander with genuine pressure-revealed choice: Zhang converts every number into lived cost (工地、四千、一年一半不着家) instead of receipting it, and his anger climbs the ladder in order — repetition counting ('答第三回了'), earned profanity ('有毛关系啊'), half-abandonment ('爱咋咋地吧') that turns back to redirect the verdict past the father to the boy. The father's evasions are choices, not recitation: he never once answers 土木还是软件, hides behind 说了算 and 签得起, and his gaze breaking off-screen at exactly the dodged questions is fine nonverbal tell-work. Escalation circles without resolving, which fits the engine.
problems: The father stays one-note across twenty-plus turns — no crack, stall, or leaked motive ever surfaces under sustained pressure, so his arc flattens into the same deflection at the same temperature
Physical vocabulary is repetitive and mechanical (right-hand jab/tap/chop variants nearly every turn on both sides), reading as generated stage business rather than distinct attention
Zhang's register is all pressure and no looseness — zero humor, digression, or self-amused detour, which makes his long exchange tonally monotone compared to his own concessive beats

reviews.verdict: Strong two-hander with a real escalation engine: the consultant's pressure moves through distinct rungs (parameter demand, pinning '哪个', repetition-counting '答第三回了', profanity release, mock-concession '爱咋咋地吧' then the return verdict aimed past the father at the boy), while the father's stonewalling is dramaturgically legible — he never answers a direct question, converts every attack back into '一本就是一本', and his authority claim ('这个家我说了算') is a genuine beat change from arguing merits to asserting rank. Physical scores are concrete and tied to speech rhythm (the aborted thermos drink, thumb-to-chest, palm chop on the verdict). Concrete stakes (589/586, 四千起薪, 半年工地) keep the argument material rather than abstract.
problems: Gesture vocabulary narrows over the long middle — finger jabs, desk taps and flat palms recycle with diminishing information; the bodies stop revealing anything the speech doesn't already carry
The final third loops back to the opening question ('让不让走一本') without the father ceding or exposing new ground, so the last three exchanges restate rather than raise the stakes

The father's cracks under pressure stay purely verbal deflection; the transcript never cashes the mid-scene gaze-drops into a visible costlier beat, leaving his interior pressure asserted more than staged
